description: Represents the provider configuration of an application component.

MCPURL.description: The MCP endpoint URL for MCP server providers.
MCPURL.title: MCPURL

errorTransformer.description: Use to transform an error before sending it back to the client.
errorTransformer.title: errorTransformer

extractors.description: List of extractors for the provider.
extractors.title: extractors

hosts.description: The list of hosts that this provider expects to receive traffic for. At least one of hosts, models or model prefixes must be set. Hosts are never inherited from the referenced provider.
hosts.title: hosts

injectors.description: Defines injection point for javascript snippet.
injectors.title: injectors

lib.description: If set, this snippet of lua will available in all extractors of the provider, acting as an effective library. It must be a valid lua module. It will be available to all extractor by doing local plib = require('plib').
lib.title: lib

modelPrefixes.description: The literal prefixes that identify this provider inside a model identifier. Third-party gateways commonly address a model as the provider they route to followed by the model name, such as 'openai/gpt-4o' or '@openai-prod/gpt-4o'. Include the separator in the entry, so 'openai/' rather than 'openai': entries are matched as a plain leading string, and the separator is what keeps 'openai/' from also matching 'openai-community/gpt2'. An entry may span several segments, so 'openrouter/openai/' and 'openrouter/' can name different providers and the longer match wins. Wildcards are not supported here; use models for those.
modelPrefixes.title: modelPrefixes

models.description: The models served by this provider, as patterns. Wildcards are supported, so 'gpt-*' covers a family. They are used to resolve a provider when a model identifier arrives with no prefix, which is what several third-party gateways send on the response side of a call. Several providers may match the same model, in which case the most specific pattern wins.
models.title: models

providerRef.description: The name of an existing provider to use as the base of this provider. The referenced provider is resolved like any other provider of the namespace. Hosts, models, model prefixes, category and provider type always come from this app component provider. MCP URL, trusted CA, description, error transformer and lib replace the ones of the referenced provider when set, and upstream unsecure is enabled when set on either. Extractors, mappers, injectors and tools are appended to the ones of the referenced provider, whose own host restrictions are dropped. If the referenced provider cannot be found, this app component provider is not rendered.
providerRef.title: providerRef

tools.description: The list of available tools for MCP server providers.
tools.title: tools

trustedCA.description: If set, additionally trust the Certificate Authorities from the PEM data. This is useful when working on a custom provider using a self signed CA chain.
trustedCA.title: trustedCA

upstreamUnsecure.description: If enabled, force the upstream scheme to be HTTP instead of https. Mostly use for dev purposes.
upstreamUnsecure.title: upstreamUnsecure

title: AppComponentProvider
